gloss: the five court musicians of a hina doll display

definitions.gloss: the five court musicians of a hina doll display
definitions.explanation: The set of five boy musicians placed on the third tier of a {雛人形|ひなにんぎょう} display for the Doll Festival. From left to right they play the {太鼓|たいこ} (drum), {大鼓|おおつづみ} (large hand drum), {小鼓|こつづみ} (small hand drum), and {笛|ふえ} (flute), with the fifth serving as the singer.

examples.japanese: {三段目|さんだんめ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{五人|ごにん}{囃子|ばやし}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{並|なら}べる→並べる：01091_naraberu⟧。
examples.english: We arrange the five court musicians on the third tier.

examples.japanese: {五人|ごにん}{囃子|ばやし}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦みんな→みんな：02972_minna⟧⟦{子供|こども}→子供：00554_kodomo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{姿|すがた}→姿：03363_sugata⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦している→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The five court musicians are all depicted as children.

examples.japanese: ⟦{祖母|そぼ}→祖母：00813_sobo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{毎年|まいとし}→毎年：00731_maitoshi⟧、⟦{内裏雛|だいりびな}→内裏雛：30615_dairibina⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧{五人|ごにん}{囃子|ばやし}⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧⟦{丁寧|ていねい}→丁寧：00896_teinei⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{飾|かざ}っていた→飾る：01185_kazaru⟧。
examples.english: Every year my grandmother carefully set out everything from the imperial dolls down to the five court musicians.

notes:
COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {五人|ごにん}{囃子|ばやし}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{飾|かざ}る→飾る：01185_kazaru⟧: to display the five musicians
- {五人|ごにん}{囃子|ばやし}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{段|だん}→段：03424_dan⟧: the tier of the five musicians
- ⟦{笛|ふえ}→笛：03593_fue⟧や⟦{太鼓|たいこ}→太鼓：04049_taiko⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{持|も}った→持つ：00478_motsu⟧{五人|ごにん}{囃子|ばやし}: the five musicians holding flute and drums

CULTURAL NOTE:
A full ⟦{雛人形|ひなにんぎょう}→雛人形：14830_hinaningyou⟧ display is tiered: the ⟦{内裏雛|だいりびな}→内裏雛：30615_dairibina⟧ (imperial couple) on top, ⟦{三人官女|さんにんかんじょ}→三人官女：30616_sanninkanjo⟧ (three court ladies) below them, and the {五人|ごにん}{囃子|ばやし} on the third tier. Because the set is so familiar, the phrase is sometimes used playfully for any group of five performers.
